acceptanceCriteria: Stubs on a configurable list of flag/config lookup constants/methods are classified separately from collaborator stubs; the validity result carries a 'conditional on flag KEY=VALUE' qualifier with the forced value and, when discoverable, the code default; a warning when forced differs from default; downstream evidence records the condition instead of an unqualified pass; RSpec fixtures plus negative control; spec amended.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1340. A cited example that forces a feature flag through a stub (allow(FlagClient).to receive(:enabled?).with(:rule).and_return(true)) proves behaviour only while the flag is on; test-validity treats it as an ordinary collaborator stub, so a rule disabled by default can be cited as unconditionally proven. Pairs with V1-2104 (#1339) in the stub-classification area.
title: Test validity: surface feature-flag stubs as a condition on the proven behaviour
